## Primary Specialization

- **Cloud & DevOps:** Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2, S3, IAM), Linux / VPS server management (Hostinger, Ubuntu), Nginx reverse proxy, PM2 process management, CI/CD pipelines, Docker basics.

- **Database & Auth:** MongoDB, Mongoose, Supabase, PostgreSQL, JWT Authentication, OAuth, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

## Services Offered
1. **Custom MERN Stack Web Applications:** End-to-end web apps, admin panels, client dashboards, and portals.
2. **SaaS MVP Development:** Rapid prototyping and building MVPs for founders with authentication, billing integrations, and scalable databases in 3-4 weeks.
3. **AWS Cloud Deployment & Architecture:** Deploying Node.js/React/Next.js apps onto AWS EC2 and S3, configuring custom domains, SSL certificates, Nginx reverse proxy, and monitoring.
4. **Performance & API Optimization:** Auditing slow full-stack apps, reducing bundle size, caching database queries, and improving Core Web Vitals.
